note: ILLUSTRATIVE SAMPLE DATA. Coordinates are approximate and the landmark notes are invented. Replace with surveyed rank data before any demo that claims accuracy.

ranks.name: Bree Street Taxi Rank
ranks.landmarkNotes: Multi-storey rank between Bree and Kerk Street. The long-distance deck is on the upper level - take the ramp on the Lillian Ngoyi side.

ranks.name: Noord Street Taxi Rank
ranks.landmarkNotes: Directly opposite the Noord Street shopping strip. Long-distance departures load from the basement level; loading bays are signposted by destination province.

ranks.name: Ermelo Taxi Rank
ranks.landmarkNotes: Main interchange for the Mpumalanga corridor. Ask for the Mbombela-bound row - the local route stands are at the opposite end of the same hall.

ranks.name: Mbombela Taxi Rank
ranks.landmarkNotes: Arrivals drop on the eastern side near the bus terminal; the mini-bus stands for White River and Hazyview are one level down.

ranks.name: White River Mini-Taxi Rank
ranks.landmarkNotes: Small open-air rank behind the main road shops. Vehicles leave once full.
